grammarFocus: he / she / it；is；a / an；单数名词；this / that。
title: At the School Gate
instructions: 这是模拟听力练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读听力原文），然后回答问题。题目中的中文说明帮助你理解。答案必须来自听力内容。
transcript: Anna: Hi, Ms. Li. This is Ben. He is new. Ben: Hello, Ms. Li. Ms. Li: Hi, Ben. This is a book. It is for you. Ben: Thank you. Ms. Li: That is a dog. It is small. Anna: Is that your dog? Ms. Li: No, it is not. It is Tom's dog. Ben: Is this your book? Ms. Li: Yes, it is. Anna: Is Ben a teacher? Ms. Li: No, he is not. He is a student.

questions.explanation: Anna 说“He is new.”，所以 Ben 是新来的。

questions.prompt: Ms. Li 给 Ben 什么？
questions.explanation: Ms. Li 说“This is a book. It is for you.”，所以给的是书。
questions.evidence: This is a book. It is for you.

questions.explanation: Ms. Li 说“It is Tom's dog.”，所以狗是 Tom 的。
Ms. Li 说“No, he is not. He is a student.”，所以 Ben 不是老师。
questions.evidence: No, he is not. He is a student.

questions.prompt: 那本书是 Ms. Li 的吗？
questions.explanation: Ben 问“Is this your book?”，Ms. Li 回答“Yes, it is.”，所以书是她的。
Ms. Li 说“It is small.”，所以狗是小的。

questions.prompt: Ms. Li 说 Ben 是 ______。（填一个单词）
questions.explanation: Ms. Li 说“He is a student.”，所以 Ben 是学生。

questions.prompt: Anna 介绍另一位说话者时说：“This is ______.”（从录音填一个人名）
questions.explanation: Anna 说“This is Ben.”，所以填 Ben。

grammar.title: he / she / it; is; a / an; 单数名词; this / that
grammar.explanation: 英语中，我们用 he 指男性，she 指女性，it 指事物或动物。is 是 be 动词，用于 he/she/it。a 或 an 用于单数名词前，表示“一个”。this 指近处的人或物，that 指远处的人或物。
grammar.example: This is Ben. He is new.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：______ is a girl. (指一个女孩)
选择正确的单词填空：This is ______ apple.
questions.explanation: apple 以元音音素开头，用 an。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：______ is a cat. (指远处的一只猫)
选择正确的单词填空：He ______ a boy.

speaking.part2: Describe a person or thing near you. You should say: who or what it is; where it is; what it looks like; and explain why you mention it.

transfer.writing: Write 2–8 simple sentences about a person or thing near you. Use 'This is...', 'He/She/It is...', and 'a/an'.
